_🎯 Functional Correctness_ | _🟡 Minor_ | _⚡ Quick win_

**Require exactly one dispatch call.**

The validator accepts every `dispatch_gate_test_families` line after the end marker. A second call passes validation and runs every selected family twice. Count dispatch calls and fail unless the count is one.

<details>
<summary>Proposed fix</summary>

```diff
-        if ($0 == "dispatch_gate_test_families") { next }
+        if ($0 == "dispatch_gate_test_families") {
+          dispatch_calls++
+          next
+        }
...
       END {
+        if (dispatch_calls != 1) {
+          printf "expected one dispatch_gate_test_families call, found %d\n", dispatch_calls > "/dev/stderr"
+          exit 1
+        }
         if (failed == 1) { exit 1 }
```
</details>

### Partition allows missing dispatch **Medium Severity** `verify_gate_family_partition` treats any number of `dispatch_gate_test_families` lines after the end marker as fine, including zero. Deleting that call still passes the structural check, defines every family, then exits 0 without running tests or printing success. That quietly greens the mapped self-test the partition was meant to protect.

findings.title: Reject focus during lock-free gate runs
findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reject focus during lock-free gate runs**

When a developer exports `GATE_TEST_FOCUS` and invokes the documented `agent-quality-gate.sh --run --no-lock` mode (or sets `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK=0`), this guard allows the focused subset to answer for the full gate. `acquire_gate_run_lock` returns immediately for that mode at `scripts/agent-quality-gate.sh:1616-1617`, before `claim_gate_run_lock` can export `AGENT_QUALITY_GATE_LOCK_HELD`, so the mapped self-test inherits the focus and silently skips the other families. Use a gate-run marker independent of lock acquisition, or explicitly reject/sanitize the focus when launching this mapped command.

findings.title: Register the new self-test path pin
findings.body:
**<sub><sub>![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Register the new self-test path pin**

This fallback introduces a hard-coded `scripts/agent-quality-gate.test.sh` pin but does not add it to the scripts path-pin inventory. The fallback is exercised when the suite is launched through a relative path from a subdirectory and then changes to the repo root; after a future script move, obvious entry points could be updated while this less-visible fallback remains stale and makes the partition check read a missing or wrong file. Register the self-source fallback with the other path-pin classes.
